name: Voxel-Based Virtual Object Relighting
definition: An image-based method to insert virtual objects into real environments and estimate light transport between real and virtual parts without manual geometric modeling, using data extracted from multiple 2.5D high dynamic range (HDR) captures stored in a voxel grid.
summary: Voxel-Based Virtual Object Relighting inserts virtual objects into real scenes by estimating light transport via voxel grids, requiring no manual modeling or offline computation.
